newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich Life sees good 1997 performance.
newsitem.headline: Zurich Life sees good 1997 performance.

text.p: Zurich Life Insurance Co., part of the Zurich Group, said its 1996 profit rose to 42.2 million Swiss francs from 1996's 34.3 million and that it expects another good performance in the current year.
Zurich said in a statement that premium income for Zurich Life rose 10.1 percent to 4.9 billion francs and higher investment income had led to an increase in profit.
"Another good performance is expected for the current business year," Zurich said about Zurich Life.
Although income from newly invested assets declined, Zurich said investment income was higher than in 1995, but it gave no figures.

Together with a reduced expense ratio, this growth led to 7.1 percent rise in gross operating surplus, enabling Zurich Life to raise its allocation to the provision for policyholders' participation in profits.

Premium volume at Zurich Life in Switzerland rose 6.7 percent as an expansion in corporate business and periodic premium business partly offset a slight decline in the volume of single premiums in personal business.
Cooperation with Swiss Bank Corp (SBC) -- involving sharing of distribution channels and the joint development of products and services -- proceeded well.
Premium volume abroad also increased 6.7 percent in local currency terms. In Swiss franc terms, premiums abroad rose 17.3 percent.
